spanish: Y las tablas las chapó de oro, y sus anillos los hizo de oro, casas para los travesaños, y chapó los travesaños de oro.
grammarChanges: Added resumptive clitic "las" before "chapó" for the fronted direct object "las tablas" (required for a left-dislocated topic in Spanish).
Added resumptive clitic "los" before "hizo" for the fronted direct object "sus anillos" (same rule).
Changed preposition "a" to "para" before "los travesaños" (purpose sense, not destination).
